lines.en: I walk slowly across the savanna.
Four feet, planted firmly.
My hide is like stone.
Horn forward, I walk on.
The grass flattens under me.
Not fast, but unstoppable.
I follow the path by the water.
The little one keeps beside me.
One step leaves a hollow.
My hide creaks as I move.

lines.zh: 尾巴扫过草尖，打掉几粒露水。
lines.en: My tail sweeps the grass tips and knocks off the dew.
I head for that patch of grass.
I stand and graze.
The horn will grow a little more.
The sun suits my back.
The little one plays further off.

lines.zh: 我什么都不用做，草会自己长。
lines.en: I need do nothing; the grass grows on its own.
I take a bite of grass.
My ears keep moving.
I lower my head and look at my horn.
The grass here is tender.
The grass stem turns slowly in my mouth.
I have to watch this area.
I scuff my foot on the ground.

lines.zh: 远处有声音，我抬了抬头。
lines.en: A sound far off; I raise my head.
This patch is quiet.

lines.zh: 鼻息喷在草上，草叶乱翻。
lines.en: My breath blows across the grass and sets it thrashing.
When the grass is gone, I'll move.
The little one bumped me.
I stand still, not moving off.
You're a bit too close.

lines.zh: 我的角很长，你看见了吗？
lines.en: Can you see how long my horn is?

lines.zh: 手放慢点，我讨厌突然的动静。
lines.en: Slow your hands; sudden movements set me off.
The little one's over there. I'm here.
This grass is mine.

lines.zh: 你袖口沾着别的兽的气味。
lines.en: Your cuff carries another beast's scent.
I could lift you on my horn.
Stay quiet and I won't move.
Put your hands down.
My temper's all right for now.
Look at this hide. Very thick.
Step back over there.
My horn angles a little toward you.
I only get angry when struck.
Put that weapon away.
I watch over this area.
That made me move.
A patch of hide came off.
A fresh gash opens in my hide.
There's a mark on my horn.
That hurt.

lines.zh: 耳朵被打得发烫，我甩头。
lines.en: My ear stings, so I shake my head.
That put me on edge.
There's an old wound on me.
The little one backed away.
I don't get hurt often.
That bunch of grass still has dew on it.
I can eat that.
Bring it here. Set it down.
Try feeding me once.
I like the tender bits.
Don't reach too close.
Is one bite enough?
This has little scent.
Put down another armful; I'm not done chewing.
Feed me and I won't drive you off.
Bumping me is like hitting a wall.
I barely shift.
My hide is harder than your armor.
Don't crowd up against my hind legs.
You gave ground, so I won't chase.
Don't drive your shoulder into my ribs.
The little one's beside us. Don't step on it.
Now we've both stopped.

lines.zh: 头一低，角尖擦过你的肩。
lines.en: Head down, my horn tip grazes your shoulder.

lines.zh: 你再撞一次我就不客气。
lines.en: Bump me again and I won't be gentle.
The savanna is quiet now.
Neither of us is loud.

lines.zh: 它的角还短，站在旁边正好。
lines.en: Her horn is still short, and she stands well beside me.
That's where the little one came from.
Don't stand over there watching.
Shoulder to shoulder, neither of us leaves.

lines.zh: 草被我们压出一块空地。
lines.en: We pressed a clearing in the grass.
Afterwards it goes back to its own side.
Careful with the horns. Don't catch.

lines.zh: 这一片地我们都会守着。
lines.en: We'll both guard this ground.
I pick up a stalk of grass.
I flipped this stone with my horn.
My hands are poor; I use my mouth.
One hook of my lip and the grass is in my mouth.
This one's too hard.
This one's underfoot, so I press it into the dirt.
I'll keep this pile of grass.
I'll only take it if you hand it over.
My mouth is big; I pick accurately.
That won't fill a tooth gap.

lines.zh: 这个距离，我已经能冲到你。
lines.en: At this distance I can already reach you.
I heard something just now.

lines.zh: 那根东西指过来，我看见了。
lines.en: That thing is pointed at me, and I see it.

lines.zh: 你盯着我的角，我记住了。
lines.en: You keep eyeing my horn, and I noted that.
Step back and I'll let it go.
You're between me and the little one.
I'm lowering my head.

lines.zh: 你要是再走一步就晚了。
lines.en: One more step and it's too late.
My horn is aimed at you.
I guard this grassland.
I'm turning slowly toward you.

lines.zh: 我一直盯着你，没眨过眼。
lines.en: I've kept my eyes on you without blinking.
Hiding in the grass won't work.
My horn points this way.
I stamped the ground once.
The little one comes with me.
You moved. I saw.
No cover in this grass.
I'm not fast, but the charge is fierce.
You shouldn't stand dead ahead.
I lower my head and charge.
My horn lifts you up.

lines.zh: 这一下能撞飞很重的东西。
lines.en: This can throw something heavy.

lines.zh: 你整个人被角挑得离了地。
lines.en: My horn lifts you clean off your feet.
I turned and kicked with a hind leg.
I stamped the grass into the mud.
You can't stop this weight.
The horn tip is blunt, but hard.
After the charge I slowed.

lines.zh: 水边是死角，我一头顶过去。
lines.en: The waterline is a dead end, so I drive my horn in.
I come from across the savanna.
The grass flattens where I step.
The little one follows me.
There's good grass here.
I let out one low note and the grass shivers.
I stand in the wind and sniff.
This ground is unclaimed.
I walk slowly to the tree.
The sun is just right.
There's still mud on my horn.
The sounds of the savanna changed.

lines.zh: 我朝草原尽头望了一眼。
lines.en: I glance toward the far edge of the savanna.
Fire caught my hide. It's hot.

lines.zh: 这么重落地，腿震了一下。
lines.en: Landing this heavy jarred my legs.

lines.zh: 水没过我的背，我喘不上气。
lines.en: Water over my back. I can't breathe.
The blast pushed me back some distance.

lines.zh: 箭扎进厚皮，只进去一点。
lines.en: The arrow went only a little into the hide.
That light went past my hide.
No grass, no strength.

lines.zh: 雷打在我角上，麻了一下。
lines.en: Lightning hit my horn and I went numb.
There's no grass in the void.
